content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Each of these platforms offers a way for digital creators to sell their digital products, but they have fundamental differences. Stripe is a payment processor that integrates into existing websites and e-commerce platforms, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy are digital storefronts that allow creators to sell directly to customers. Paddle is a payment and subscription management platform for software sellers. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a complete sovereign digital commerce stack that provides automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership for digital creators in restricted countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries, but Nigeria is not one of them. Gumroad is available in most countries but has limitations and restrictions. Lemon Squeezy is not available in many countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. Paddle is available in over 160 countries but has limitations and restrictions. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is specifically designed for digital creators in restricted countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, providing a permanent structural alternative to these platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, while Gumroad charges 3.5% + 30¢ per transaction. Lemon Squeezy charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, but has a $25 monthly plan for creators with more sales. Paddle charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, but has a $39 monthly plan for creators with more sales. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) charges a one-time fee of $197 for deployment, with no monthly or transaction fees, and offers automatic crypto payment processing with a 0.5% fee.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Each of these platforms has its own approach to ownership, automation, and delivery. Stripe requires creators to integrate their own payment logic, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy handle payment processing and delivery for creators. Paddle handles payment processing, subscription management, and delivery for software sellers. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership for digital creators, allowing them to automate their business and focus on creating more content.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture depends on the specific needs and goals of the digital creator. If speed and convenience are key, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy may be a good choice. If scalability and flexibility are important, Paddle may be a better option. However, for digital creators in restricted countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the best choice due to its infrastructure sovereignty and permanent structural alternative to standard payment infrastructure.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
